newsitem.title: USA: PENA SUPPORTS BOLIVIA'S RURAL ELECTRIFICATION PLAN.
newsitem.headline: PENA SUPPORTS BOLIVIA'S RURAL ELECTRIFICATION PLAN.

text.p: U.S. Energy Secretary Federico Pena agreed on Wednesday to send a letter of support for a pending World Bank loan to Bolivia for rural electrification, the Department of Energy said.
Pena was part of a U.S. delegation attending the inauguration of Gen. Hugo Banzer Suarez as president on Bolivia on behalf of President Bill Clinton, the Department said on Wednesday.
The project is expected to bolster counternarcotics efforts by expanding electricity and bringing alternative economic opportunities to rural areas in Bolivia.

Pena and Banzer also discussed the economic benefits of expanding investments in renewable energy projects. Bolivia has significant hydroelectric, wind, geothermal and solar resources that could be tapped for both electric grid and off-grid applications.

The secretary stressed the importance of stability in Bolivia's investment climate, including the maintenance of existing contracts. He offered U.S. expertise in the area of renewable energy to aid in the implementation of the electricity program.
